description: Add infinite marquee scroll to Ticker with pause on hover and gradient fade edges. Add animated connecting line between Roadmap steps, number counter animation when in view, icon hover animations, and slide+fade entrance for step cards. Must preserve all existing navigation links and roadmapSteps data rendering.
steps: 1. In src/components/sections/Ticker.jsx: Double the items array to create seamless loop. Wrap items in motion.div with animate={{ x: [0, -50%] }} and transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 20, ease: 'linear' }}. Add onHoverStart/End to pause animation using useAnimation hook

2. In src/components/sections/Ticker.css: Add gradient fade masks on left and right edges using ::before/::after with background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--paper), transparent) and pointer-events: none. Add overflow: hidden to container

3. In src/components/sections/Roadmap.jsx: Add vertical connecting line using ::before pseudo-element on .steps container. Animate line height from 0 to 100% using motion.div with whileInView and scaleY transform (transform-origin: top)

4. In src/components/sections/Roadmap.jsx: Create animated counter for step numbers. Use useInView hook and useEffect to trigger count animation from 0 to step.number. Use motion.span with animate={{ opacity: [0,1] }} for each digit change

5. In src/components/sections/Roadmap.css: Add @keyframes icon-bounce for step-num on hover. Add .step-link:hover .step-num with animation: icon-bounce 0.3s ease. Add transform-origin: center for bounce effect
6. In src/components/sections/Roadmap.jsx: Enhance stepVariants with x: -30 to x: 0 slide animation combined with opacity fade. Add custom delay multiplier and viewport once:true setting
7. Verify: Run 'npm run build'. Confirm Link to='/lessons?filter=${step.route}' navigation preserved for all roadmap steps.
acceptance_criteria: Ticker items scroll infinitely in marquee style without visible jump/reset
Ticker animation pauses smoothly when user hovers over it
Ticker has gradient fade on left and right edges
Roadmap has animated vertical line connecting all steps that draws on scroll
Step numbers animate counting up from 0 when they enter viewport
Step icons have bounce/scale animation on hover
Step cards slide in from left with fade when scrolled into view
npm run build passes with no errors

findings: Implemented all animations using Framer Motion. Ticker uses useAnimationControls for pause-on-hover. Roadmap uses useInView for counter animation and scaleY for connecting line animation. All navigation links preserved.
